description: This file defines an interface for catalog item service operations in a Blazor shared project, including methods for creating, editing, deleting, retrieving by ID, and listing catalog items.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: An interface declaring methods for catalog item operations such as create, edit, delete, retrieve, and list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item with the specified request data.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by its ID.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Returns a paged list of catalog items based on page size.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns a list of all catalog items.
